02 / How the check works

Arc emits an 18-decimal native USDC Transfer event for each explicit USDC movement. An ERC-20 call also emits a 6-decimal mirror event. Adding both would double-count the payment.

We use only the canonical native system emitter, exclude mints, burns and self-transfers from invoice amounts, and subtract explicit transfers out of the recipient in the same transaction. Gas is calculated separately from the receipt.

A successful transaction may still pay the wrong recipient or amount. “Amount matched” means the net explicit USDC credit equals the amount entered. It does not establish a contract, unique invoice allocation, or payer identity. Results rely on the public RPC; there is no independent node or cryptographic receipt-proof verification.
